definitions.explanation: Prefix indicating the complete sum or entirety.
Prefix indicating the head or overall position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{総額|そうがく}→総額：05472_sougaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百万円|ひゃくまんえん}になった。
examples.english: The total amount came to one million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{総理|そうり}{大臣|だいじん}→総理大臣：15205_souridaijin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会見|かいけん}→会見：11447_kaiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The Prime Minister held a press conference.

examples.japanese: {総選挙|そうせんきょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A general election will be held next month.
examples.notes: {総|そう} + {選挙|せんきょ} = general election

examples.japanese: {総人口|そうじんこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧⟦{一億|いちおく}→一億：08929_ichioku⟧{二千万|にせんまん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧だ。
examples.english: The total population is approximately 120 million.

examples.japanese: ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{総計|そうけい}→総計：15248_soukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please calculate the grand total of expenses.

examples.japanese: {総監督|そうかんとく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指揮|しき}→指揮：11102_shiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: The general director took charge of the whole operation.

notes:
{総|そう}〜 is a prefix meaning 'total' or 'general/chief.'

COMMON COMPOUNDS (TOTAL):
- ⟦{総額|そうがく}→総額：05472_sougaku⟧ (total amount)
- ⟦{総数|そうすう}→総数：20724_sousuu⟧ (total number)
- ⟦{総計|そうけい}→総計：15248_soukei⟧ (grand total)
- ⟦{総合|そうごう}→総合：16986_sougou⟧ (comprehensive; synthesis)
- ⟦{総務|そうむ}→総務：16143_soumu⟧ (general affairs)

COMMON COMPOUNDS (GENERAL/CHIEF):
- ⟦{総理|そうり}→総理：13856_souri⟧ (Prime Minister; management)
- {総長|そうちょう} (president of university; director-general)
- ⟦{総裁|そうさい}→総裁：13890_sousai⟧ (president; governor)
- {総選挙|そうせんきょ} (general election)
- ⟦{総会|そうかい}→総会：13855_soukai⟧ (general meeting)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧〜 (all; whole) - similar meaning but different nuance
- {総|そう} emphasizes aggregation; ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ emphasizes completeness
